written_by: Maat (Fable 5.1), 7 Oct 2026, for Al's ruling. Revised 16:30: no place names (Al's ruling — the photo rotates by weekday and hour, not by the user's town, so a line must never name one).
rules: review/HUMOUR-DOCTRINE.md and review/PAIRING-TASTE.md bind. One line per photo, two beats, second turns, 9-14 words, no captioning the frame, no town or landmark names. Afrikaans is written, not translated; run it through the lang gate as usual.

partly-cloudy/dawn-1.png.en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.
partly-cloudy/dawn-1.png.af: Son in, son uit. Maandag warm nog net op.

partly-cloudy/dawn-2.png.en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.
partly-cloudy/dawn-2.png.af: Die wolke het die son Dinsdag afgegee. Niemand het die klamheid laat weet nie.

partly-cloudy/dawn-3.png.en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.
partly-cloudy/dawn-3.png.af: Daai wolke is net op deurtog. Selfs die mielies raak nie opgewonde nie.

partly-cloudy/dawn-4.png.en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.
partly-cloudy/dawn-4.png.af: Die skaduwee werk die rye een vir een af. Dis besig met inspeksie.

partly-cloudy/dawn-5.png.en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.
partly-cloudy/dawn-5.png.af: Pers op die grond, wit in die lug. Vrydag se kleure is goedgekeur.

partly-cloudy/dawn-6.png.en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
partly-cloudy/dawn-6.png.af: 'n Paar wolke het kom kyk. Hulle hardloop ook nie.

partly-cloudy/dawn-7.png.en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.
partly-cloudy/dawn-7.png.af: Die wolke dryf stadig verby. Dis Sondag; hulle mag.

partly-cloudy/day-1.png.en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
partly-cloudy/day-1.png.af: Die berg se tafeldoek is net half op. Dis Maandag, niemand is heeltemal aangetrek nie.

partly-cloudy/day-2.png.en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.
partly-cloudy/day-2.png.af: Wolkskaduwees stap teen 'n rustige pas oor die veld. Niemand appelleer nie.

partly-cloudy/day-3.png.en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.
partly-cloudy/day-3.png.af: Son, dan wolk, dan son. Selfs die apies kan nie daarvolgens beplan nie.

partly-cloudy/day-4.png.en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
partly-cloudy/day-4.png.af: Die hond het die presiese lyn tussen son en skadu gekry. Hy bly net daar.

partly-cloudy/day-5.png.en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.
partly-cloudy/day-5.png.af: Sonbril op, sonbril af, sonbril op. Vrydagmiddag is intervaloefening.

partly-cloudy/day-6.png.en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
partly-cloudy/day-6.png.af: Een wolk oor die berg is nie weer nie. Die vuur bly aan.

partly-cloudy/day-7.png.en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.
partly-cloudy/day-7.png.af: Wolk oor die berg, potjie onder die lapa. Albei kort nog 'n uur.

partly-cloudy/dusk-1.png.en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.
partly-cloudy/dusk-1.png.af: Die wolke het laat gebly net vir die kleur. Maandag skuld almal soveel.

partly-cloudy/dusk-2.png.en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.
partly-cloudy/dusk-2.png.af: Wolke die hele middag, nie 'n druppel nie. Die tuinslang is weer aan diens.

partly-cloudy/dusk-3.png.en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.
partly-cloudy/dusk-3.png.af: Die lug hou 'n vertoning. Die vis, soos gewoonlik, nie.

partly-cloudy/dusk-4.png.en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
partly-cloudy/dusk-4.png.af: Wolke vir die sonsondergang, sproeiers vir die wingerd. Die plaas reël sy eie reën.

partly-cloudy/dusk-5.png.en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
partly-cloudy/dusk-5.png.af: Die son het afgeteken. Die wolke gloei nog, en die balkon ook.

partly-cloudy/dusk-6.png.en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.
partly-cloudy/dusk-6.png.af: Die wolke het pienk geword net toe dit tyd was om op te pak. Niemand het opgepak nie.

partly-cloudy/dusk-7.png.en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
partly-cloudy/dusk-7.png.af: Die beeste is tuis voor die kleur weg is. Sondag eindig presies op tyd.

partly-cloudy/night-1.png.en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.
partly-cloudy/night-1.png.af: Die maan is vanaand op 'n dimmer. Die sekuriteitslig het nie so 'n knoppie nie.

partly-cloudy/night-2.png.en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.
partly-cloudy/night-2.png.af: Halfmaan, halfwolk, vol drom. Dinsdagaand, soos geadverteer.

partly-cloudy/night-3.png.en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.
partly-cloudy/night-3.png.af: Die maan loer kort-kort uit om die vulstasie te check. Steeds niks aan die gang nie.

partly-cloudy/night-4.png.en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
partly-cloudy/night-4.png.af: Die wolke gee die maan vir mekaar aan. Die balkon wag graag.

partly-cloudy/night-5.png.en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.
partly-cloudy/night-5.png.af: Die maan kom tussen die wolke deur kuier. Hy ruik die vleis van daar bo af.

partly-cloudy/night-6.png.en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
partly-cloudy/night-6.png.af: Die helfte van die sterre is agter wolke. Die liggies staan vir hulle in.

partly-cloudy/night-7.png.en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
partly-cloudy/night-7.png.af: Maan agter 'n wolk, hond op die stoep. Sondag se diens is verby.

breezy/dawn-1.png.en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
breezy/dawn-1.png.af: Die vlag gee die voorspelling voor die branderplankryers. Dit sê: gaan.

breezy/dawn-2.png.en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.
breezy/dawn-2.png.af: Die jakarandablomme ry ook bus. Die bries het hulle kaartjies gekoop.

breezy/dawn-3.png.en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.
breezy/dawn-3.png.af: Die windpomp doen die oggend se werk. Die gras waai hom net aan.

breezy/dawn-4.png.en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.
breezy/dawn-4.png.af: Hand op die pet, een tree op 'n slag. Die bries hou haar pas.

breezy/dawn-5.png.en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.
breezy/dawn-5.png.af: Die wasgoed is droog voor eerste pouse. Die bries het vroeg begin werk.

breezy/dawn-6.png.en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
breezy/dawn-6.png.af: 'n Klein stofduiweltjie ry voor hom uit. Dit trap nie eens nie.

breezy/dawn-7.png.en: Her hair got to the bakery first. The breeze has its own Sunday plans.
breezy/dawn-7.png.af: Haar hare was eerste by die bakkery. Die bries het sy eie Sondagplanne.

breezy/day-1.png.en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
breezy/day-1.png.af: Pouse, en die bries doen almal se hare. Die juffrouens ook.

breezy/day-2.png.en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.
breezy/day-2.png.af: Die bries werk vandag by die vrugtestalletjie. Lugverkoeling ingesluit, geen ekstra koste nie.

breezy/day-3.png.en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.
breezy/day-3.png.af: Die bries doen al die werk. Die vlieër kry al die eer.

breezy/day-4.png.en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.
breezy/day-4.png.af: Die hoekvlag wys presies waarheen die doelskoppe gaan trek.

breezy/day-5.png.en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.
breezy/day-5.png.af: Die lakens is al droog. Nou spog die bries net vir die kind.

breezy/day-6.png.en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.
breezy/day-6.png.af: Die rook het die bure se erf gekry. Saterdag se braai is amptelik 'n gemeenskapsgeleentheid.

breezy/day-7.png.en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.
breezy/day-7.png.af: Skoene op die kombers se hoeke. Die bries is welkom, die sand nie.

breezy/dusk-1.png.en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
breezy/dusk-1.png.af: Vlae styf uit, wynglas styf vas. Die dek se weergawe van 'n kalm Maandag.

breezy/dusk-2.png.en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.
breezy/dusk-2.png.af: Die stof gaan vir goud in die laaste lig. Die wedstryd speel daardeur voort.

breezy/dusk-3.png.en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.
breezy/dusk-3.png.af: Die heuwel beweeg in golwe. Die beeste het besluit om dit nie raak te sien nie.

breezy/dusk-4.png.en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.
breezy/dusk-4.png.af: Die bries skuif die jakaranda een straat aan, blommetjie vir blommetjie. Die stoep keur dit goed.

breezy/dusk-5.png.en: The cat is unmoved. Everyone else is delighted, especially the sarong.
breezy/dusk-5.png.af: Die kat is onbewoë. Almal anders is in hul skik, veral die sarong.

breezy/dusk-6.png.en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
breezy/dusk-6.png.af: Die wasgoed moes ure gelede al in gewees het. Die bries het gestem om dit te los.

breezy/dusk-7.png.en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.
breezy/dusk-7.png.af: Die vlae gesels nog. Die bote het die week afgesluit.

breezy/night-1.png.en: Leaves keep blowing through the security light. It keeps switching on for nobody.
breezy/night-1.png.af: Blare waai aanhoudend deur die sekuriteitslig. Hy skakel aanhoudend aan vir niemand.

breezy/night-2.png.en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.
breezy/night-2.png.af: Iemand het die wasgoed vergeet. Die bries nie, en dit doen 'n pragtige werk.

breezy/night-3.png.en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.
breezy/night-3.png.af: Die bries is nog warm op hierdie uur. Die see los die verwarming die hele nag aan.

breezy/night-4.png.en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.
breezy/night-4.png.af: Die windpomp glo nie aan afklopstyd nie. Die hond ook nie.

breezy/night-5.png.en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
breezy/night-5.png.af: Die bries vat die rook met die straat af. Die hele buurt weet wat vir aandete is.

breezy/night-6.png.en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
breezy/night-6.png.af: Elke liggie aan die string swaai. Saterdagaand het ritme, net-net.

breezy/night-7.png.en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.
breezy/night-7.png.af: Die sand steek die pad oor, een korrel op 'n slag. Niemand hier het haas nie.

cloudy/dawn-1.png.en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.
cloudy/dawn-1.png.af: Die lug is op stil en die ry ook. Maandag het nog nie sy volume gekry nie.

cloudy/dawn-3.png.en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.
cloudy/dawn-3.png.af: Lug en see het vanoggend oor 'n kleur ooreengekom. Nie 'n opwindende een nie.

cloudy/dawn-4.png.en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.
cloudy/dawn-4.png.af: Selfs die hadida hou dit sag. Die lug het die toon aangegee.

cloudy/dawn-5.png.en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.
cloudy/dawn-5.png.af: Die berg het die duvet oor sy kop getrek. Verstaanbaar, dis Vrydag.

cloudy/day-1.png.en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
cloudy/day-1.png.af: Geen skaduwees, geen skittering, geen verskonings nie. Maandag onder 'n Tupperware-deksel.

cloudy/day-2.png.en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
cloudy/day-2.png.af: Die son gaan nie vandag die blink kom inspekteer nie. Die kar is tevrede.

cloudy/day-3-weekB.png.en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
cloudy/day-3-weekB.png.af: Die hele veld met die kleur afgedraai. Die skape tel dieselfde, hoe ook al.

cloudy/day-4.png.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
cloudy/day-4.png.af: Nie een skaduwee op die veld die hele dag nie. Die skeidsregter het nie een keer sy oë op skrefies getrek nie.

cloudy/day-5.png.en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
cloudy/day-5.png.af: Grys lug, truie aan, skool is uit. Die naweek vra nie die son se toestemming nie.

cloudy/dusk-1.png.en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
cloudy/dusk-1.png.af: Die lug het van liggrys na donkergrys gegaan. Dit was die hele vertoning.

cloudy/dusk-3.png.en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.
cloudy/dusk-3.png.af: Die sekuriteitslig het vroeg aangegaan. Die son het nooit behoorlik ingeklok nie.

cloudy/dusk-4.png.en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
cloudy/dusk-4.png.af: See en lug in bypassende grys. Net die pier se liggies het moeite gedoen.

cloudy/dusk-7.png.en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
cloudy/dusk-7.png.af: Die skuur se gloeilamp is vanaand se sonsondergang. Die beeste aanvaar die afgradering.
